method.timing: Uninstrumented public installed exports. One process, modules imported once before timing; fresh engine owner each repetition, not process/module cold. Fresh-index first query separately recorded. Two discarded warmups, five measured calls per query per owner. Timings ceil-rounded to whole milliseconds including owned scheduled yields, promises and complete exact-total/page work. No heap or physical latency qualification. Receivers are fresh owners containing a literal prior record before restore.
method.work: One separately untimed observer owner per configuration/size. Trusted installed-private ExecutionOwner.admit generator wrapper counts actual emitted work-v1 steps/units/max step, including failed operations until their last emitted step. A failing attempted charge need not be emitted. Timing comparisons exclude this wrapper. Counts/entries are logical diagnostics, not retained or peak heap.

configurations.query: Native exact ASCII text AND, exact full total plus deterministic BM25 top20. Strict phrase additionally requires same token sequence in one original field value.
configurations.filter: No filter/facet requested. Core scalar equality is available; extended metadata predicates and facets are uninstalled in these measured configurations.
configurations.count: Exact complete membership count before top20.
configurations.evidence: No Inspector, range/snippet output or rendering requested.
configurations.analyzer: basic-v1 NFKC then lowercase; this ASCII fixture does not compare Unicode platform behavior.
configurations.limits: Unchanged default admission, corpus, search/mutation work and optional participant bounds. Deadline 60000ms; batchSize256.

limitations: Synthetic ASCII cycles are cost fixtures, not relevance data or general capacity qualification.
Same-process runs are temporally ordered, not randomized across operating-system states.
Sample maximum is a tail observation over 3 owner operations or 15 warm calls, not a population percentile.
Native snapshots use exact local Node qualification only; browser native snapshots remain unqualified.
Known source restoration work-limit failures remain rejected with preserved old state.
No UI rendering, physical paint, heap/GC, device, AT, disk power-loss or cross-browser qualification is claimed.

method.limit: Complete namespace export graphs overlap; bytes must not be added as disjoint runtime costs. Snapshot module graph includes explicit native/source codec exports. Standalone adapter runtime excludes application-owned engine unless core is also selected. UI runtime/CSS bytes are not render-time or heap observations.
